formula_lines_source.name: formula_lines_source
formula_lines_source.value:
case "formula_lines"."kind"
        when 'labour' then "formula_lines"."sector_id" is not null and "formula_lines"."material_id" is null and "formula_lines"."article_option_id" is null
        else "formula_lines"."sector_id" is null and (("formula_lines"."material_id" is null) <> ("formula_lines"."article_option_id" is null))
      end

product_options_range.name: product_options_range
product_options_range.value: "product_options"."min" is null or "product_options"."max" is null or "product_options"."min" <= "product_options"."max"
